therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Multi-kinase inhibition combined with immune checkpoint blockade
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor angiogenesis inhibition and T-cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with mismatch repair proficient/microsatellite stable colorectal cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall Response Rate (ORR) per RECIST v1.1

safety_signals: Grade 3-5 adverse events in 68.6% of patients
Serious adverse events in 48.6% of patients
results.dose_information: Regorafenib oral tablets daily for 3 weeks of each 28-day cycle (3 weeks on, 1 week off); Nivolumab administered on day 1 of every treatment cycle
